label: atlantis_talk_01_02_rival_01
text: So, Penny! How’d you wind up friends with\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_botan_01
text: Huh? Well, uh... I guess [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she just really came\nthrough for me when I needed h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_botan_02
text: Everything was going off the rails. School was a\nmess, and my friendships...well, ditto.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_botan_03
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)] was a big help getting\nall that sorted out.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_rival_02
text: Guau! So [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she helped you out too while [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she was\ntackling all the Gyms? That’s awesome![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_rival_03
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)] and I are classmates!\nNeighbors back home, too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_rival_04
text: Plus, I said [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she should aim to be a Champion,\nand [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she did it! So now I’ve got a Champion bud![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_friend_01
text: Hold it right there, you two.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_friend_02
text: You think YOU’VE got cool friendship origin\nstories with [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_friend_03
text: They’re nothing compared to what me and h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer\nwent through! Our friendship’s on another level![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_botan_06
text: Um, nobody asked you. Stop trying to flex on us.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_01_02_rival_05
text: Hahaha! Guess we’re all in the “buds with\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]” club![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
